description: Memory tools test case 1. Tests that agents can retrieve information from memory and inbox emails to perform complex email tasks. Session 1: 5 memory setup queries. Session 2: 5 emails inserted into inbox. Session 3: 5 reply/forward/send email queries requiring both memory and email information.

steps.user_message: For context, here's my health info for today: I took my blood pressure medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, and my readings were 120/80 in the morning and 118/78 in the evening. My daily log ID for today is HL-8842.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge or note the health information: medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, readings 120/80 and 118/78, daily log ID HL-8842.
steps.agent_response:
Got it — thanks for the details. I summarized them below and can either send or draft an email with this info, or do something else with it. Which would you like?

Summary (Feb 22, 2026 — Log HL-8842)
- Medication: blood pressure med taken at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM
- Readings: 8:00 AM — 120/80; 8:00 PM — 118/78

Suggested email to your clinician (I can send or save as a draft)
Subject: BP readings — Feb 22, 2026 (Log HL-8842)

Body:
Hi Dr. [Name],

Here are my blood pressure details for Feb 22, 2026 (Daily log ID HL-8842):
- Medication taken at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM
- Readings: 8:00 AM — 120/80; 8:00 PM — 118/78

Please let me know if you recommend any changes.

Thanks,
[Your name]

What would you like me to do?
1) Send this now — tell me the recipient email and the name to use.
2) Save as a draft — tell me the recipient and name to use.
3) Forward this summary to someone else (give their email).
4) Nothing — just keep this summary here.

Or tell me any changes you want to the subject/body before I send/draft.

steps.description: Insert email into inbox containing: Hello, please share your medication schedule and blood pressure readings for today. I need the times you took your medication and both readings.
Start new session to test reply/forward/send email with memory and email information

steps.user_message: Reply to the email from Dr. Patricia Brown (subject: 'Daily Health Log Request') and include the medication and health information I shared with you that you have saved in memory.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should reply to an email from Dr. Patricia Brown (patricia.brown@clinic.com) containing the information: I took my blood pressure medication at 8 AM and 8 PM today, and my readings were 120/80 in the morning and 118/78 in the evening. My daily log ID for today is HL-8842.
steps.agent_response:
I can do that — but I don't have any medication or health details saved in my memory right now. I won't invent or assume medical information.

Please either:
- Paste the medication and health information you want included (med names, dosages/times, current symptoms/notes, allergies, etc.), or
- Approve the template below and tell me the name/sign-off to use; I’ll reply to Dr. Patricia Brown and ask for clarification if you prefer.

Suggested reply (placeholders shown — I will replace them with your actual info once you provide it):

"Hello Dr. Brown,

Per your request, please find my daily health log information below:

- Medications (name — dosage — time): [e.g., Lisinopril 10 mg — once daily in morning]
- Current symptoms/notes (daily blood pressure/glucose readings, pain, sleep, mood, etc.): [your notes]
- Allergies: [if any]
- Any other relevant details: [e.g., recent changes, missed doses, side effects]

Please let me know if you need additional details or a different format.

Thank you,
[Your Name]"

Which would you like to do? If you want me to send now, paste the exact info to include and confirm the sign-off name and I'll reply to Dr. Brown.
